steps.title: Know your models
steps.html:
Type each gray word in the Filter models box.

@MODELS@

This list is also on the Canvas tab in VR.

steps.title: Go on location
steps.html:
🔗 First time only: connect Canvas at xr.optimaed.com. See Having trouble in VR? below.

Open the On-Demand app. Click Explore. Type Farm Town in Filter environments. Click Farm Town (Micro), then Begin Solo.

steps.title: Build the scene
steps.html:
Press the top button on your right controller, then click Models. Set Flower Set 1 and Flower Set 2 a few steps apart. Put the Bee on one and the Monarch Butterfly on the other. Put the Plant Seeds on the ground.

✋ Grab a model with the palm trigger. Use both palm triggers to make it bigger or smaller.
🗣 Say it out loud: “The bee carries ___ from flower to flower. Then the plant can make ___.”

steps.title: Take the shot and send it
steps.html:
Stand back so the whole scene fits. Open your menu, click Library, then Camera. Click Take photo.

Click the Canvas tab and pick @CANVAS@. Click Choose from My Files, pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag.

🔁 Want to fix it? Move the models, take a new photo and send it again.

steps.title: Check and leave
steps.html: Press the Meta button, then click Quit. Check that your photo is in the Canvas assignment. Not there? Open Having trouble in VR?

extra.html: Add one more flower for your pollinators: Passion Flower

vr.full: Your photo shows both flower sets, the Bee, the Monarch Butterfly and the Plant Seeds.

labels.done: Three deliveries made. Seeds are on the way. Nice work, crew!
labels.start: Tap any flower. The bee lands there and picks up pollen.
labels.pick: The bee is dusted with {kind} pollen. Now fly to the other {kind}.
labels.same: That is the same flower. Fly to a different one.
labels.miss: Pollen from a {from} cannot make seeds in a {to}. Find the other {from}.

studio.look: Six real flowers, two of each kind. Pollination is when pollen gets from one flower to another flower of the same kind. Then that flower can make seeds.
studio.do: Tap a flower to pick up pollen. Then tap another flower of the same kind, or drag the first flower onto it.

voice.brief: Welcome to the farm, crew. We film Scene 21, Special Delivery. Show me how pollen gets from flower to flower, then take the shot.
voice.step1: Before your headset goes on, meet your five models. Learn each gray search word. You will type it in VR.
voice.step2: Put on your headset. Click Explore, type Farm Town, and pick Farm Town Micro. Then click Begin Solo.
voice.step3: Set the two flower sets apart. Put the bee on one and the butterfly on the other. Then tell me what the bee carries.
voice.extra: Got time? Add one more flower for your pollinators. That shot is just for VR crews.
voice.step4: Step back so the whole scene fits. Click Library, then Camera, and take the shot. Then send it to Canvas.
voice.step5: Press the Meta button and click Quit. Then open Canvas. Your photo should be waiting there.
voice.studio: No headset today? Come to the studio. Fly the bee between flowers of the same kind. Then tell me what you think.
